newsitem.title: USA: Dow Chemical has no comment on lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chemical has no comment on lawsuit.

text.p: A Dow Chemical Co spokesman said the company had not seen the complaint brought against it and its unit, Dow Enviromental Inc, and can not therefore comment on its specifics.
Dan Fellner, a Dow Chemical spokesman, noted, however, that the company "has acted in an entirely appropriate manner concerning this issue."

Earlier today, a group of 38 current and former employees of Dow Enviromental said they sued both companies for alleged unlawful termination of retirement benefits involving $20 million in stock appreciation rights.
